name: RGIT Cube Open 2018

venue.name: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Technology
venue.address: Rajiv Gandhi institute of Technology, Juhu Versova Link Road, Versova, Mumbai 400053

information:
**New Participants**
Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA
Step 2 - Register for the competition
Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RGITCubeOpen2018#4217-registration-payment). 
**Returning participants**
Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions.
Step 2 - Register for the competition.
Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RGITCubeOpen2018#4217-registration-payment).
Registration for the event will only be accepted if a person has preregistered on the WCA page AND made the payment.
For more details on the registration process please check the [registrations&payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RGITCubeOpen2018#4217-registration-payment).
For the competition Schedule please check the [schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RGITCubeOpen2018#4218-schedule).
***The registration is on 1st come 1st serve basis, only the 1st 100 participants will be allowed to participate **

***Note : No Shorts or 3/4ths will be allowed inside the college campus for both girls and boys. It is compulsory to carry an identity card (school/college/ aadhar card etc) for entry at the gate***
